title: The 90-second tour

items.caption: Today: what's due, films in production, the best new fits.
Jobs, ranked by how well you fit, and why.
A 30-second film made for one company.
The messages that go with it, in the order you send them.
Who watched, and how far they got.
One clear ask, signed by the sender.

end: Take the tour: no sign-in, no waiting.
